description: Source code for Wi-Fi Virtual Access Point (VAP) management, including functions for creating, destroying, enabling/disabling VAPs, handling station stats, neighbor management, WPS configuration, and related Wi-Fi features.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_createHook
methods.description: Creates a hook for a given Access Point, validating input.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_destroyHook
methods.description: Destroys a hook for a given Access Point, cleaning up event listeners and interfaces.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_ssid
methods.description: Gets or sets the SSID of the Access Point.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the Access Point, including interface info.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the VAP, with options for direct set.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the VAP configuration.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_sec_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes security settings of the VAP.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_setMboDisallowReason
methods.description: Sets the MBO disallow reason for the VAP.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_multiap_update_type
methods.description: Updates the multi-AP type.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_multiap_update_profile
methods.description: Updates the multi-AP profile.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_multiap_update_vlanid
methods.description: Updates the VLAN ID for multi-AP.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_sta_transfer
methods.description: Transfers station to another AP.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_sendManagementFrame
methods.description: Sends a management frame.

methods.name: s_addDelNeighbor
methods.description: Adds or deletes a neighbor entry for the AP.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_deleted_neighbor
methods.description: Deletes a neighbor entry.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_updated_neighbor
methods.description: Updates or adds a neighbor entry.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_setDiscoveryMethod
methods.description: Sets the discovery method (RNR) for the AP.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_setMldUnit
methods.description: Configures MLD unit for MLO capabilities.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_mf_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes MAC filtering list.

methods.name: s_syncRelayCredentials
methods.description: Handles relay WPS credentials synchronization.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_wps_sync
methods.description: Handles WPS configuration synchronization.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_wps_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables WPS.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_wps_labelPin
methods.description: Sets WPS label or PIN.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_kick_sta_reason
methods.description: Kicks a station with a specific reason.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_disassoc_sta_reason
methods.description: Disassociates a station with a reason.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_kick_sta
methods.description: Kicks a station for invalidation.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_clean_sta
methods.description: Removes a station from the AP.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_updateApStats
methods.description: Updates AP statistics.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_requestRrmReport
methods.description: Requests RRM report for a station.

methods.name: s_reloadApNeighbors
methods.description: Reloads neighbor list for the AP.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_postUpActions
methods.description: Actions after AP is brought up.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_postDownActions
methods.description: Actions after AP is brought down.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_getStationStats
methods.description: Retrieves station statistics for the AP.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_getSingleStationStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a single station.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_updateRssiStats
methods.description: Updates RSSI statistics.

methods.name: wifiGen_vap_getMloStats
methods.description: Retrieves MLO link statistics.
